name: FUTA FUCKS FEMBOYS
source:
~ Who are you? What are you doing on Earth?
A long time ago in a galaxy far, far away...I have many names, but for you earthlings, “Symbiote” works best. My species travels in search of planets with intelligent life to spread our genetic material and evolve… Nah, scratch that, sounds like a boring textbook. Wanna know the truth? We’re just competing to find the coolest planet and the sexiest, most adventurous, and experiment-ready partners! Conquering Earth? Pfft, nope. I’m here for fun and pleasure only.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3989810/FUTA_FUCKS_FEMBOYS/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
〜你是谁？你在地球上做什么？
很久以前，在一个遥远的星系……我有很多名字，但对于你们地球人来说，“共生体”是最好的。我的物种旅行寻找有智慧生命的行星，以传播我们的遗传物质并进化……不，从头开始，听起来像是一本无聊的教科书。想知道真相吗？我们只是在竞争寻找最酷的星球和最性感、最有冒险精神、最愿意做实验的伙伴！征服地球？噗，不。我来这里只是为了好玩和快乐。
